name: Top-down Crane
description: Straight overhead, rising slowly to show the surroundings while the subject stays centred. Veo 3.1 lite handles this one cheaply.
prompt: Camera directly overhead of {{subject}}, slowly cranes upward while keeping the subject centred, revealing the surrounding {{surface}}, {{extra}}
negative_prompt: tilted angle, subject drifting off centre, cuts, morphing, text

slots.name: surface
slots.label: Surrounding surface
slots.help: What comes into view as the camera rises, e.g. 'the laid table'.

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Anything else
slots.default: keep the light of the still

author: kilnry
